verses.text: After di death of Moses di servant of di Lord, di Lord speak to Joshua di pikin of Nun, Moses servant, talk,
“Moses my servant don die. Now, rise up, cross dis Jordan, you and all dis people, go enter di land wey I dey give to dem, to di pikin dem of Israel.
Every place wey di sole of your foot go step on, I don give am to you, as I talk to Moses.
From di wilderness and dis Lebanon, reach di great river, di river Euphrates, all di land of di Hittites, and to di great sea toward where di sun dey go down, go be your border.
No man go fit stand before you all di days of your life. As I dey with Moses, so I go dey with you. I no go fail you, I no go leave you.
Be strong and get courage, because you go make dis people inherit di land wey I swear to dem papa dem say I go give dem.

Only be strong and get plenty courage, so that you go keep and do according to all di law wey Moses my servant command you. No turn from am to di right hand or to di left, so that you go prosper any place wey you go.

Dis book of di law no go comot from your mouth, but you go meditate on am day and night, so that you go keep and do according to all wey dem write inside am. Because den you go make your way prosper, and den you go get good success.
I no command you? Be strong and get courage. No fear. No shake, because di Lord your God dey with you any place wey you go.”
Den Joshua command di officers of di people, talk,

“Go through di middle of di camp, and command di people say, ‘Prepare food, because within three days una go cross dis Jordan, to go enter possess di land wey di Lord una God dey give una to possess.’”
Joshua speak to di Reubenites, di Gadites, and di half-tribe of Manasseh, talk,
“Remember di word wey Moses di servant of di Lord command una, talk say, ‘Di Lord una God dey give una rest, and e go give una dis land.’

Una wives, una small pikin dem, and una livestock go stay for di land wey Moses give una for di other side of Jordan, but una go cross before una brothers with weapon, all di mighty men of valour, and una go help dem,

until di Lord don give una brothers rest, as e don give una, and dem don also possess di land wey di Lord una God dey give dem. Den una go return to di land of una possession, and possess am, wey Moses di servant of di Lord give una for di other side of Jordan toward where di sun dey rise.”
Dem answer Joshua, talk say, “Everything wey you command us, we go do, and any place wey you send us, we go go.
As we listen to Moses for all things, so we go listen to you. Only make di Lord your God dey with you, as e dey with Moses.
Anybody wey rebel against your commandment, and no listen to your words for all wey you command am, dem go put am to death. Only be strong and get courage.”
Joshua di pikin of Nun send two men from Shittim go spy secretly, talk say, “Go, look di land, and Jericho too.” Dem go, and enter di house of one prostitute wey im name na Rahab, and sleep dere.
Dem tell di king of Jericho say, “Look, some men from di pikin dem of Israel don come here tonight to search out di land.”
Di king of Jericho send message to Rahab, talk say, “Bring out di men wey come to you, wey enter your house, because dem come to search out all di land.”
Di woman take di two men, and hide dem, and talk say, “Yes, di men come to me, but I no know wia dem come from.
E happen say about di time wey dem dey close di gate, when darkness don fall, di men go out. Wia di men go, I no know. Chase dem quick, because una go catch dem.”
But e don carry dem go up to di roof, and hide dem under di flax stalks wey e arrange for di roof.
Di men chase dem go di road to Jordan, reach di fords. As soon as di men wey dey chase dem go out, dem close di gate.
Before di two men lie down, e go up to dem for di roof,
and talk to di men say, “I know say di Lord don give una di land, and say fear of una don fall on us, and say all di people wey dey live for di land dey melt away before una.

Because we don hear how di Lord dry up di water of di Red Sea before una, when una come out of Egypt, and wetin una do to di two kings of di Amorites, wey dey di other side of Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, wey una utterly destroy.
As soon as we hear am, our hearts melt, and no spirit remain again for any man because of una, because di Lord una God, na im na God for heaven above, and for earth below.
Now, I dey ask una, swear to me by di Lord, since I don show kindness to una, say una go also show kindness to my papa house, and give me one sure sign,
and say una go save alive my papa, my mama, my brothers, and my sisters, and all wey dem get, and deliver our lives from death.”
Di men talk to am say, “Our life for your own, if you no talk about dis business of ours. E go be say, when di Lord give us di land, we go show you kindness and truth.”
Den e let dem down with rope through di window, because im house dey for di side of di wall, and e dey live on di wall.
E talk to dem say, “Go to di mountain, so that di people wey dey chase you no meet you. Hide yourselves dere three days, until di people wey dey chase you return. After dat you fit go your way.”
Di men talk to am say, “We no go get blame for dis your oath wey you make us swear.

Look, when we come into di land, you must tie dis line of scarlet thread for di window wey you use let us down. You must gather your papa, your mama, your brothers, and all your papa household come inside di house.

E go be say anybody wey go out from di doors of your house enter di street, im blood go dey on im own head, and we no go get guilt. Anybody wey dey with you inside di house, im blood go dey on our head, if anybody put hand on am.
But if you talk about dis business of ours, den we no go get guilt of your oath wey you make us swear.”
E talk say, “Make e be according to una words.” E send dem go, and dem go, and e tie di scarlet rope for di window.
Dem go, and reach di mountain, and stay dere three days, until di people wey dey chase dem return. Di people wey dey chase dem look for dem all along di road, but dem no see dem.
Den di two men return, come down from di mountain, cross over, and come to Joshua di pikin of Nun, and tell am everything wey happen to dem.
Dem talk to Joshua say, “Truly di Lord don deliver all di land into our hands. Moreover all di people wey dey live for di land dey melt away before us.”
Joshua rise early for morning, and dem leave Shittim, come reach Jordan, e and all di pikin dem of Israel, and dem stay dere before dem cross.
E happen say after three days, di officers go through di middle of di camp,
and dem command di people say, “When una see di ark of di covenant of di Lord una God, and di priests wey be Levites dey carry am, den una must leave una place and follow am.
But space must dey between una and am, about 2,000 cubits by measure. No come near am, so that una go know di way wey una must follow, because una never pass dis way before.”
Joshua talk to di people say, “Make una self holy, because tomorrow di Lord go do wonders among una.”
Joshua speak to di priests, talk say, “Carry di ark of di covenant, and cross before di people.” Dem carry di ark of di covenant, and go before di people.
Di Lord talk to Joshua say, “Today I go begin to make you great for di eyes of all Israel, so that dem go know say as I dey with Moses, so I go dey with you.
You must command di priests wey dey carry di ark of di covenant say, ‘When una reach di edge of di waters of Jordan, una must stand still inside Jordan.’”
Joshua talk to di pikin dem of Israel say, “Come here, and hear di words of di Lord una God.”

Joshua talk say, “By dis una go know say di living God dey among una, and say e go surely drive out from before una di Canaanites, di Hittites, di Hivites, di Perizzites, di Girgashites, di Amorites, and di Jebusites.
Look, di ark of di covenant of di Lord of all di earth dey cross before una enter Jordan.
Now take 12 men from di tribes of Israel, one man for every tribe.

E go happen say, when di soles of di feet of di priests wey dey carry di ark of di Lord, di Lord of all di earth, rest inside di waters of Jordan, di waters of Jordan go cut off from di water wey dey flow come down, and di waters wey dey come down from above go stand as one heap.”
When di people leave dem tents to cross Jordan, di priests wey dey carry di ark of di covenant dey go before di people,
and when di men wey dey carry di ark reach Jordan, and di feet of di priests wey dey carry di ark touch di edge of di water, because Jordan dey overflow all im banks for all di time of harvest,

di waters wey dey come down from above stand, and rise up as one heap, far away, for Adam, di city wey dey beside Zarethan. Di waters wey dey go down toward di sea of di Arabah, even di Salt Sea, cut off completely. Den di people cross near Jericho.
Di priests wey dey carry di ark of di covenant of di Lord stand firm on dry ground for di middle of Jordan, and all Israel cross on dry ground, until all di nation don finish to cross Jordan.
When all di nation don finish to cross Jordan, di Lord speak to Joshua, talk,
“Take 12 men from di people, one man from every tribe,
and command dem say, ‘Take 12 stones from di middle of Jordan, from di place wia di priests feet stand firm. Carry dem cross with una, and put dem down for di place wia una go sleep dis night.’”
Den Joshua call di 12 men wey e don choose from di pikin dem of Israel, one man from every tribe.

Joshua talk to dem say, “Cross before di ark of di Lord una God go di middle of Jordan, and each one of una carry one stone put am on im shoulder, according to di number of di tribes of di pikin dem of Israel,
so that dis go be sign among una, so that when una pikin dem ask for time wey dey come, say, ‘Wetin dis stones mean to una?’

den una go tell dem say, ‘Na because di waters of Jordan cut off before di ark of di covenant of di Lord. When e cross Jordan, di waters of Jordan cut off.’ Dis stones go be memorial for di pikin dem of Israel forever.”

Di pikin dem of Israel do so as Joshua command, and carry 12 stones from di middle of Jordan, as di Lord speak to Joshua, according to di number of di tribes of di pikin dem of Israel. Dem carry dem cross with dem go di place wia dem sleep, and put dem down dere.
Joshua set up 12 stones for di middle of Jordan, for di place wia di feet of di priests wey dey carry di ark of di covenant stand. Dem dey dere till today.

Di priests wey dey carry di ark stand for di middle of Jordan, until everything finish wey di Lord command Joshua make e talk to di people, according to all wey Moses command Joshua. Di people hurry cross.
When all di people don finish to cross, di ark of di Lord cross, and di priests, before di people.
Di pikin dem of Reuben, pikin dem of Gad, and di half-tribe of Manasseh cross ready for war before di pikin dem of Israel, as Moses speak to dem.
About 40,000 men wey ready for war cross before di Lord go battle, to di plains of Jericho.
For dat day di Lord make Joshua great for di eyes of all Israel, and dem fear am, as dem fear Moses, all di days of im life.
Di Lord speak to Joshua, talk,
“Command di priests wey dey carry di ark of di testimony make dem come up from Jordan.”
So Joshua command di priests say, “Come up from Jordan.”

When di priests wey dey carry di ark of di covenant of di Lord come up from di middle of Jordan, and di soles of di priests feet touch dry ground, di waters of Jordan return to dem place, and overflow all im banks as before.
Di people come up from Jordan for di tenth day of di first month, and camp for Gilgal, for di east border of Jericho.
Dem 12 stones, wey dem take from Jordan, Joshua set up for Gilgal.
E talk to di pikin dem of Israel say, “When una pikin dem ask dem papa dem for time wey dey come, say, ‘Wetin dis stones mean?’
den una go make una pikin dem know, say, ‘Israel cross dis Jordan on dry land.’
Because di Lord una God dry up di waters of Jordan from before una, until una cross, as di Lord una God do to di Red Sea, wey e dry up from before us, until we cross,
so that all di peoples of di earth go know di hand of di Lord, say e dey mighty, so that una go fear di Lord una God forever.”

When all di kings of di Amorites wey dey di other side of Jordan toward di west, and all di kings of di Canaanites wey dey by di sea, hear how di Lord dry up di waters of Jordan from before di pikin dem of Israel, until dem cross, dem heart melt, and no spirit remain inside dem again because of di pikin dem of Israel.
For dat time di Lord talk to Joshua say, “Make flint knives, and circumcise di pikin dem of Israel again, for di second time.”
Joshua make flint knives, and circumcise di pikin dem of Israel for di hill of di foreskins.
Dis na di reason wey Joshua circumcise: all di people wey come out of Egypt, wey be males, even all di men of war, die for di wilderness for di road, after dem come out of Egypt.
Because all di people wey come out dem circumcise, but all di people wey dem born for di wilderness for di road as dem dey come out of Egypt, dem no circumcise dem.

Di pikin dem of Israel waka 40 years for di wilderness, until all di nation, even di men of war wey come out of Egypt, finish, because dem no listen to di voice of di Lord. Di Lord swear to dem say e no go let dem see di land wey di Lord swear to dem papa dem say e go give us, land wey dey flow with milk and honey.
Dem pikin dem, wey e raise up for dem place, na dem Joshua circumcise, because dem never circumcise, since dem no circumcise dem for di road.
When dem finish to circumcise all di nation, dem stay for dem places for di camp until dem heal.
Di Lord talk to Joshua say, “Today I don roll away di reproach of Egypt from una.” So dem call di name of dat place Gilgal, till today.
Di pikin dem of Israel camp for Gilgal, and dem keep di Passover for di fourteenth day of di month for evening for di plains of Jericho.
Dem eat from di produce of di land for di next day after di Passover, unleavened bread and roasted grain, for di same day.
Di manna stop for di next day, after dem don eat from di produce of di land. Di pikin dem of Israel no get manna again, but dem eat from di fruit of di land of Canaan dat year.

When Joshua dey near Jericho, e lift up im eyes and look, and look, one man dey stand before am with im sword wey dem don draw for im hand. Joshua go meet am, and talk to am say, “You dey for us, or for our enemies?”
E talk say, “No, but as prince of di army of di Lord I don come now.” Joshua fall face down to di earth, and worship, and talk to am say, “Wetin my oga dey talk to im servant?”
Di prince of di army of di Lord talk to Joshua say, “Comot your shoes from your feet, because di place wia you dey stand dey holy.” Joshua do so.
Now Jericho don close up tight because of di pikin dem of Israel. Nobody go out, and nobody come in.
Di Lord talk to Joshua say, “Look, I don give Jericho into your hand, with im king and im mighty men of valour.
You must go round di city, all di men of war, go round di city one time. You must do dis for six days.
Seven priests go carry seven trumpets of ram horns before di ark. For di seventh day you go go round di city seven times, and di priests go blow di trumpets.

E go be say when dem blow ram horn long, and when you hear di sound of di trumpet, all di people go shout with big shout, and di wall of di city go fall down flat, and di people go go up, every man straight before am.”
Joshua di pikin of Nun call di priests, and talk to dem say, “Carry di ark of di covenant, and make seven priests carry seven trumpets of ram horns before di ark of di Lord.”
Dem talk to di people say, “Move forward! Go round di city, and make di men wey ready for war pass before di ark of di Lord.”

E happen so, say when Joshua don speak to di people, di seven priests wey dey carry di seven trumpets of ram horns before di Lord move forward, and blow di trumpets, and di ark of di covenant of di Lord follow dem.
Di men wey ready for war go before di priests wey dey blow di trumpets, and di rear guard go after di ark, di trumpets dey sound as dem dey go.
Joshua command di people say, “Una no go shout, nor make una voice hear, and no word must comot from una mouth, until di day wey I tell una make una shout. Den una go shout.”
So e make di ark of di Lord go round di city, one time. Den dem come back into di camp, and sleep for di camp.
Joshua rise early for morning, and di priests carry di ark of di Lord.

Di seven priests wey dey carry di seven trumpets of ram horns before di ark of di Lord dey go continually, dey blow di trumpets, and di men wey ready for war dey go before dem, and di rear guard come after di ark of di Lord, di trumpets dey sound as dem dey go.
For di second day dem go round di city one time, and return into di camp. Dem do dis for six days.
E happen for di seventh day say dem rise early as day dey break, and go round di city di same way seven times. Na only for dat day dem go round di city seven times.
E happen for di seventh time, when di priests don blow di trumpets, Joshua talk to di people say, “Shout, because di Lord don give una di city!
Di city go be devoted thing, even am and all wey dey inside am, to di Lord. Only Rahab di prostitute go live, e and all wey dey with am for di house, because e hide di messengers wey we send.
But as for una, only keep una self from di devoted thing, so that una no go take di devoted thing and make di camp of Israel accursed, and bring trouble on am.
But all di silver, and gold, and vessels of bronze and iron, dem dey holy to di Lord. Dem must enter di treasury of di Lord.”

So di people shout, and di priests blow di trumpets. When di people hear di sound of di trumpet, di people shout with big shout, and di wall fall down flat, so that di people go up into di city, every man straight before am, and dem take di city.
Dem utterly destroy all wey dey inside di city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, and sheep, and donkey, with di edge of di sword.
Joshua talk to di two men wey spy out di land say, “Go into di house of di prostitute, and bring out di woman from dere, and all wey e get, as una swear to am.”
Di young men wey be spies go in, and bring out Rahab, and im papa, and im mama, and im brothers, and all wey e get. Dem bring out all im relatives too, and dem put dem outside di camp of Israel.
Dem burn di city with fire, and all wey dey inside am. Only di silver, and di gold, and di vessels of bronze and of iron, dem put inside di treasury of di house of di Lord.
But Rahab di prostitute, and im papa household, and all wey e get, Joshua save alive. E dey live for di middle of Israel till today, because e hide di messengers wey Joshua send to spy out Jericho.

Joshua make dem swear for dat time, talk say, “Cursed be di man before di Lord wey rise up and build dis city Jericho. E go lay im foundation with di loss of im firstborn, and set up im gates with di loss of im youngest pikin man.”
So di Lord dey with Joshua, and im fame dey for all di land.

But di pikin dem of Israel commit trespass with di devoted thing, because Achan di pikin of Carmi, di pikin of Zabdi, di pikin of Zerah, of di tribe of Judah, take some of di devoted thing, and di anger of di Lord burn against di pikin dem of Israel.
Joshua send men from Jericho go Ai, wey dey beside Beth Aven, for di east side of Bethel, and speak to dem, talk say, “Go up and spy out di land.” Di men go up and spy out Ai.
Dem return to Joshua, and talk to am say, “No make all di people go up. Make about 2,000 or 3,000 men go up and strike Ai. No make all di people suffer dere, because dem no plenty.”
So about 3,000 men from di people go up dere, and dem run before di men of Ai.
Di men of Ai kill about 36 of dem, and dem chase dem from before di gate reach Shebarim, and strike dem for di slope. Di hearts of di people melt, and turn like water.
Joshua tear im clothes, and fall face down to di earth before di ark of di Lord until evening, e and di elders of Israel, and dem put dust on dem heads.

Joshua talk say, “Ah, di Lord God, why you bring dis people cross Jordan at all, to deliver us into di hand of di Amorites, to make us perish? I wish say we don stay satisfy for di other side of Jordan!
Lord, wetin I go talk, after Israel don turn dem back before dem enemies!
Because di Canaanites and all di people wey dey live for di land go hear am, and dem go surround us, and cut off our name from di earth. Wetin you go do for your great name?”
Di Lord talk to Joshua say, “Get up! Why you fall face down like dis?
Israel don sin, and dem don also break my covenant wey I command dem, because dem don take some of di devoted thing, and dem don steal, and lie, and dem don put am among dem own things.

So di pikin dem of Israel no fit stand before dem enemies. Dem dey turn dem back before dem enemies, because dem don become accursed. I no go dey with una again, unless una destroy di devoted thing from among una.

Rise up, make di people holy, and talk say, ‘Make una self holy for tomorrow, because di Lord, di God of Israel, talk say, “Devoted thing dey for di middle of una, Israel. Una no fit stand before una enemies until una comot di devoted thing from among una.”

For morning una go come near by una tribes. E go be say di tribe wey di Lord choose go come near by families, and di family wey di Lord choose go come near by households, and di household wey di Lord choose go come near man by man.
E go be say di one wey dem catch with di devoted thing, dem go burn am with fire, e and all wey e get, because e don break di covenant of di Lord, and because e don do foolish thing for Israel.’”
So Joshua rise up early for morning, and bring Israel near by dem tribes, and dem catch di tribe of Judah.
E bring di family of Judah near, and e take di family of di Zerahites. E bring di family of di Zerahites near man by man, and dem catch Zabdi.
E bring im household near man by man, and dem catch Achan di pikin of Carmi, di pikin of Zabdi, di pikin of Zerah, of di tribe of Judah.
Joshua talk to Achan say, “My pikin man, I dey ask you, give glory to di Lord, di God of Israel, and confess to am, and tell me now wetin you do. No hide am from me.”
Achan answer Joshua, talk say, “Truly I don sin against di Lord, di God of Israel, and dis na wetin I do.

When I see among di spoil one beautiful Babylonian garment, and 200 shekels of silver, and one wedge of gold wey im weight na 50 shekels, den I covet dem, and take dem. Look, dem hide dem inside di earth for di middle of my tent, and di silver dey under am.”
So Joshua send messengers, and dem run go di tent, and look, e dey hide for im tent, with di silver under am.
Dem take dem from di middle of di tent, and bring dem to Joshua, and to all di pikin dem of Israel, and dem put dem down before di Lord.

Joshua, and all Israel with am, take Achan di pikin of Zerah, and di silver, and di garment, and di wedge of gold, and im pikin man dem, and im pikin woman dem, and im cattle, and im donkeys, and im sheep, and im tent, and all wey e get, and dem carry dem go up to di valley of Achor.
Joshua talk say, “Why you bring trouble to us? Di Lord go bring trouble to you today.” All Israel stone am with stones, and dem burn dem with fire, and stone dem with stones.
Dem raise one big heap of stones over am, wey dey dere till today, and di Lord turn from di fierceness of im anger. So dem call di name of dat place di valley of Achor, till today.
Di Lord talk to Joshua say, “No fear, and no shake. Take all di warriors with you, and rise, go up to Ai. Look, I don give di king of Ai into your hand, and im people, and im city, and im land.
You go do to Ai and im king as you do to Jericho and im king, only im spoil and im livestock, you go take am for yourselves. Set ambush for di city, behind am.”
So Joshua rise, and all di warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua choose 30,000 men, di mighty men of valour, and send dem out for night.
E command dem say, “Look, una go hide for ambush against di city, behind di city. No go far from di city, but make all of una ready.
I and all di people wey dey with me go go near di city. E go happen say, when dem come out against us, as for di first time, we go run before dem.
Dem go come out follow us, until we draw dem comot from di city, because dem go talk say, ‘Dem dey run before us, as for di first time.’ So we go run before dem.
Den una go rise up from di ambush, and take possession of di city, because di Lord una God go deliver am into una hand.
E go be say when una don take di city, una go set di city on fire. Una must do according to di word of di Lord. Look, I don command una.”
Joshua send dem go, and dem go di place of ambush, and hide between Bethel and Ai, for di west side of Ai, but Joshua sleep dat night among di people.
Joshua rise up early for morning, and gather di people, and go up, e and di elders of Israel, before di people go Ai.
All di people, even di men of war wey dey with am, go up, and draw near, and reach before di city, and camp for di north side of Ai. Now one valley dey between am and Ai.
E take about 5,000 men, and set dem for ambush between Bethel and Ai, for di west side of di city.
So dem set di people, even all di army wey dey for di north of di city, and dem ambush for di west of di city, and Joshua go dat night into di middle of di valley.

E happen say, when di king of Ai see am, im and im people hurry rise up early, and di men of di city go out against Israel to battle, for di time wey dem don fix, before di Arabah, but e no know say ambush dey against am behind di city.
Joshua and all Israel pretend say dem don lose before dem, and run follow di road of di wilderness.
Dem call all di people wey dey inside di city together to chase dem, and dem chase Joshua, and dem draw dem go far from di city.
Nobody remain for Ai or Bethel wey no go out follow Israel, and dem leave di city open, and chase Israel.
Di Lord talk to Joshua say, “Stretch out di javelin wey dey your hand toward Ai, because I go give am into your hand.” Joshua stretch out di javelin wey dey im hand toward di city.
Di ambush rise quick from dem place, and dem run as soon as e stretch out im hand, and enter di city, and take am, and dem hurry set di city on fire.

When di men of Ai look back, dem see, and look, di smoke of di city dey go up to di sky, and dem no get power to run go any side. Di people wey run go di wilderness turn back against di people wey dey chase dem.
When Joshua and all Israel see say di ambush don take di city, and say di smoke of di city dey go up, den dem turn back, and strike di men of Ai.
Di ambush men come out from di city against dem, so dem dey for di middle of Israel, some for dis side, and some for dat side. Dem strike dem, so tay dem no leave any of dem remain or escape.
Dem catch di king of Ai alive, and bring am to Joshua.

E happen say, when Israel finish to kill all di people wey dey live for Ai for di field, for di wilderness wia dem chase dem, and dem all fall by di edge of di sword until dem finish, all Israel return go Ai, and strike am with di edge of di sword.
All wey fall dat day, both men and women, na 12,000, even all di people of Ai.
Because Joshua no draw back im hand wey e use stretch out di javelin, until e utterly destroy all di people wey dey live for Ai.
Only di livestock and di spoil of dat city Israel take for dem own self, according to di word of di Lord wey e command Joshua.
So Joshua burn Ai, and make am heap forever, even desolation, till today.

E hang di king of Ai on one tree until evening, and as di sun dey go down, Joshua command make dem bring im body down from di tree, and throw am for di entrance of di gate of di city, and raise one big heap of stones over am, wey dey dere till today.
Den Joshua build one altar to di Lord, di God of Israel, for Mount Ebal,

as Moses di servant of di Lord command di pikin dem of Israel, as dem write am for di book of di law of Moses, one altar of stones wey dem no cut, wey nobody don lift any iron on. Dem offer burnt offerings on am to di Lord, and sacrifice peace offerings.
E write dere on di stones one copy of di law of Moses, wey e write before di pikin dem of Israel.

All Israel, strangers and native-born too, with dem elders and officers and dem judges, stand for both sides of di ark before di priests wey be Levites, wey dey carry di ark of di covenant of di Lord. Half of dem dey before Mount Gerizim, and half of dem before Mount Ebal, as Moses di servant of di Lord command for di beginning, say dem go bless di people of Israel.
After dat e read all di words of di law, di blessing and di curse, according to all wey dem write for di book of di law.
No word dey of all wey Moses command wey Joshua no read before all di assembly of Israel, with di women, and di small pikin dem, and di strangers wey dey among dem.
